response.query: Which differential-privacy mechanism (Laplace/Geometric/Report-noisy-max) and epsilon/delta ranges balance re-identification risk and data utility for SmartCard/GPS sharing?
response.answer: For SmartCard/GPS sharing, Laplace differential privacy with epsilon ranges typically balances re-identification risk and data utility. Commonly used delta values range from 0.01 to 0.1 for fine-tuning.
